resources.string: Protect keys with device authentication
Protect media and index keys
Require device authentication to use the encryption keys for private photos and videos and the independent key for the private index.
The private index closes when you lock or leave the album, or put the app in the background. Closing the index keeps an already-prepared encrypted backup intact.
Removing or resetting your device screen lock can make these keys unusable and permanently block access. Export an encrypted backup before continuing.
Protecting media encryption keys and the independent index key. Please wait for the operation to finish.
Authenticate with your device again to continue protecting the media and index keys.
Protection could not be completed. Authenticate again and retry.
